how we can design for the future in an uncertain present.
the design of systems that are useful in a post-collapse world.
the design of sociotechnical practices in the present that can be sustained and maintained in the future, when resources are scarce.

the future is uncertain, and that the future is now.

we are interested in the future of the past.

collapse informatics and practice are not just a matter of preparing for a future of scarcity; it is a way to reframe how we think about the present, and the role of the future in the present.
